title: Set up the sum
text: The present value of the payment made $$n$$ years from now is $$\frac{C}{\left(1+r\right)^n}$$. The total is a geometric series with first term $$\frac{C}{1+r}$$ and ratio $$\frac{1}{1+r}$$.

title: Sum the series
text: This geometric series sums to $$\frac{C}{r}$$. With $$C=9000$$ and $$r=0.05$$, $$P=\frac{9000}{0.05}=180000$$.
